name: io.github.y2-intel/mcp
title: Y2 MCP
description: Connect MCP-compatible agents to Y2 docs, OpenAPI, reports, news, and Agent Y2.

environmentVariables.name: Y2_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Scoped Y2 API key for reports, news, and Agent Y2 tools.

environmentVariables.name: Y2_MCP_ENABLE_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Set to true only when Agent Y2 account actions are intended.

environmentVariables.name: Y2_MCP_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose profile, webhook, and delivery mutation tools.

environmentVariables.name: Y2_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Y2 API base URL.

environmentVariables.name: Y2_DOCS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Y2 docs base URL.

environmentVariables.name: Y2_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum text characters returned for formatted JSON results.
